notes.title: Patch Notes for Oct 26
notes.content:
Inescapable's latest update fixes the following issues:

[list]
[*] Isak's friendship achievement is now reachable
[*] You can no longer bring people back from the dead by fishing
[*] Mia's friendship event will no longer spawn right after Eva's trivia
[*] Exploded buildings no longer exist in later events
[*] Loading a previous save no longer carries your decisions over in certain situations
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Thank you all for your early support of Inescapable and for your patience. Late last night we began receiving reports of an issue that would cause users to get stuck (or return to) an earlier trivia-style game later in the game, breaking the game flow.

We have now resolved this issue for all platforms. This fix is currently deploying on Steam and will soon deploy on consoles.

For some players, this may require that you load a previous save game (if you have saved during the "broken" part). Start-of-day saves are a good candidate for this, and the affected days should be Day 26 and Day 57.

Once again, we'd like to thank you for your patience and for playing Inescapable!

[i][b]- The Inescapable Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Inescapable: No Rules, No Rescue will launch October 19th!
notes.content:
[b]Hello again from Team Inescapable![/b]

As we hurtle toward launch, we now have a definitive date! Inescapable: No Rules, No Rescue will release on PC and Consoles on October 19th, 2023.

To celebrate this exciting announcement, we've made a brand new trailer, with some never-before-seen footage. There are even some hidden hints at what awaits on the island. 👀🏝️

[previewyoutube=alrcFFpc2GQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Beginning today and running through to next week, we'll also be participating in the Steam Visual Novel Fest! If you have yet to play the [i]Inescapable[/i] demo, now is the perfect time to check it out, share your thoughts, and start that theorycrafting!

If you'd care to keep up with new Inescapable news, announcements, and sneak peeks at what's ahead, be sure to wishlist Inescapable on Steam, and follow the game's [url=https://twitter.com/inescapablegame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://instagram.com/inescapablegame]Instagram[/url] accounts!

We hope you enjoy the new trailer and the [i]Inescapable[/i] demo, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts!

[b]- The [i]Inescapable[/i] Team[/b]

notes.title: Inescapable — Dev Stream & Chat!
notes.content:
[b]Inescapable Fans[/b],

To all of you who have played the demo thus far this Next Fest, the Dreamloop team would like to extend our warmest thanks! After quietly working on [i]Inescapable[/i] for so long, it has been incredible to finally see the gaming community's reaction and to hear your thoughts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799473/60f22155e732474997808eca5bfb1caaf2eb1db5.png[/img]

We're excited to be joining the Steam community again for another live stream of the [i]Inescapable[/i] demo, and thought we'd add an exciting twist. [b]One member of the Dreamloop team has not been told what the demo contains.[/b] That's right—you'll be able to see one member of our team's [b]FIRST REACTIONS[/b] to [i]Inescapable[/i]'s plot and characters [b]live [/b]tomorrow at 16:00 EEST / 14:00 BST / 06:00 PDT!

We hope that those of you interested in [i]Inescapable[/i] will join us for this exciting and fun moment. We would also like to take this opportunity to ask that you all wishlist Inescapable on Steam, and follow along with our development journey on [url=https://twitter.com/inescapablegame]Twitter[/url].

See you soon!

[b]- The Inescapable Team[/b]

notes.title: Play the Inescapable: No Rules, No Rescue Demo Now
notes.content:
[b]Inescapable fans,[/b]

A moment many of you have been eagerly anticipating has now arrived. We've just released
the demo of [i]Inescapable: No Rules, No Rescue[/i]. In this glimpse of the early game, you'll be
introduced to Harrison, [i]Inescpable[/i]'s protagonist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799473/8d6ad57644cf31c6aa2b035c3b52836e1d9c5e24.png[/img]

Throughout [i]Inescapable[/i], you will serve as Harrison's moral compass, guiding his actions as
he navigates his forced participation in a twisted reality TV series made for depraved
audiences to devour on the dark web. You'll also meet the 10 other "contestants" who will
be joining Harrison as the show's "cast".

Harrison and the other contestants have been kidnapped and taken to an abandoned island
resort. The rules of the reality show are simple. For six months, anything goes. There are no
rules for how the contestants can behave, and there will be no rescue.

At the end of their six-month stay, each of the contestants will receive €500,000. [i][b]If they
survive.[/b][/i]

Your actions and decisions will shape the fate of the contestants over the course of their
six-month stay. In its final form, [i]Inescapable[/i] will feature multiple narrative paths which alter
based on your choices. There is more to them than just different endings, however. The
show will change based on how you steer Harrison's moral compass.

We look forward to hearing your thoughts on the [i]Inescapable[/i] demo, and we look forward to
you finding answers to two of Inescapable's biggest questions.

Can you trust them? Can you be trusted?

[b]- The Inescapable Team[/b]
